summary.text: Susan DeRoy is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives who has represented Strafford 3 since December 2024 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a banking executive and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Susan DeRoy was born in York, Maine, and earned a high school diploma from R.W. Traip Academy.

According to information she submitted to Ballotpedia in 2024, her career experience includes working as a banking executive, part owner of a multinational multimedia company, and small business owner.
The same submission lists her affiliations as Rochester Rotary, the Sanford Chamber of Commerce, Kiwanis, the Monarch School of New England, Frisbie Hospital, and Rochester Economic Development.
DeRoy succeeded David Bickford (R) and assumed office on December 4, 2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.
